newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-HAYNES MAKES UNBEATEN 66 AGAINST E.P..
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HAYNES MAKES UNBEATEN 66 AGAINST E.P..

text.p: Veteran West Indian opener Desmond Haynes made a polished 66 not out for Western Province on a rain-shortened opening day at St Georges Park on Friday.
Haynes' solid knock against Eastern Province came off 163 balls as his side reached 150 for one in 51.2 overs before play was called off for the day in their four-day Supersport Series cricket match.
Only three and a half hours' play were possible as Eastern Province's rain-disrupted season continued.
After a delayed start at 13:50 p.m. because of overnight and morning rain, Haynes and Sven Koenig gave the visitors a confident start.
The opening pair took the score to 81 before the left-handed Koenig top-edged a hook to be caught at long leg off Mornantau Hayward for 27.

That, however, was E.P.'s solitary success of the day. Jacques Kallis stood firm to smack six sparkling boundaries in his undefeated 33 and, if the rain stays away, Western Province will be looking to build a huge total when play resumes on Saturday.
To bat: H.D.Ackerman, J.Commins, E.Simons, P.Kirsten, D.Rundle, C.Matthews, M.Pringle, B.Schultz.
Bowling: Hayward 13.2-0-46-1, Baptiste 17-5-39-0, Botha 11-2-26-0, Shaw 9-2-25-0, Callaghan 1-1-0-0.
Eastern Province - G.Victor, M.Beamish, L.Koen, K.Wessels, D.Callaghan, M.Rushmere, G.Morgan, E.Baptiste, T.Shaw, W.Botha, M.Haywood.
Bonus points: Eastern Province - nil; Western Province - one.
